import json, yaml, datetime, jsonschema
text = open('journals/2026-08-20-order-500s-null-price.md').read()
core = yaml.safe_load(text.split('---')[1])
schema = json.load(open('.claude/skills/investigate/journal.schema.json'))
def norm(o):
    if isinstance(o, dict): return {k: norm(v) for k, v in o.items()}
    if isinstance(o, list): return [norm(v) for v in o]
    if isinstance(o, datetime.datetime): return o.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')

core = norm(core)
jsonschema.validate(core, schema)
